title: Implement canonical runtime baseline for Wheelwright evolution
description: Execution controller for the first canonical runtime batch under epic-session15-fleet-evolution. This lug exists so the implementer can load one durable record and understand sequence, review expectations, safe delegation boundaries, verification gates, and how to report implementation feedback without relying on the user to restate the mission. The batch canonicalizes track storage, wakeup/closeout behavior, signal handling, and spoke-state expectations, while deferring README.md and framework/docs/llms-full.md rewrite until runtime behavior is stable.
verification_performed: Verified track format spec teaches canonical session directories as write target
Verified wai.md files use canonical track paths and signal handling
Verified wai-closeout.md files route signals via high-impact lugs in WAI-Lugs.jsonl

Confirmed legacy references are marked as compatibility-era only
